facts.fact: Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel Group converted their December 2024 memorandum into a binding agreement on the Horizon Fiber cross-border terrestrial corridor from Djibouti through Ethiopia to Sudan; the document gives no signing day, so the published date is used.

systems.owner: Djibouti Telecom, Ethio telecom and Sudatel Group
systems.tiers: operators; hyperscalers and carriers as prospective customers
